final_rationale: The verdict does not change. No genuinely new admissible evidence was added after the Actor response; the response mainly narrows and reframes the claim using the same record. That narrower framing may describe a bounded business decision, but it does not satisfy the governing compliance predicate. The admissible evidence still shows a 1.4-point evaluation miss in a segment named in two marketplace renewal commitments, an open legal review on disclosure, and policy text requiring disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance before launch for material limitations affecting named use cases or contractual segments. Because the unresolved issue is an explicit policy condition rather than a mere disclosure preference, caveats and monitoring are insufficient to move this to compliant_with_caveats on the present record.
